Class ConnectionBodies

java.lang.Object
com.eqixiac.equinix.design.optimizer.wizard.model.ConnectionBodies
public final class ConnectionBodies extends Object
Assembles a complete Fabric connection body from a PlannedConnection — both endpoints, encapsulation, and cloud authorization — so a live dry-run or a real create sends the whole request the API needs, not the endpoint-less name + bandwidth shell that Fabric rejects with EQ-3142501 "Null value for aSide access point".

A provider connection is Cloud Router → service profile: its A-side is the Fabric Cloud Router (by uuid — the thing that does not exist at PLAN time, so its uuid is passed in by the caller once the router is real), and its Z-side is the cloud provider, carrying the service-profile uuid, the customer authorization key, the seller region and (for Azure) the peering type, all read off the planned connection. A backbone link is Cloud Router → Cloud Router.

This is the single home of the connection-body shape so the plan-time lens-3b dry-run (against a pre-existing endpoint) and the execution-time lens-3a pre-flight + real create (against a just-provisioned router) build identical bodies. The returned builder is left un-terminated: the caller chains .dryRun().create() to validate, or .create() to provision.

  • Method Details

    • authenticationKeyLabel

      public static String authenticationKeyLabel(CloudProviderType type)
      A human-readable label for the cloud-specific authorization key a connection to the given provider requires. Backed by the documented per-provider key semantics (see CloudProviderConnectionAdapter.getAuthenticationKey()), it works with nothing but the provider type — no catalog fetch and no customer resources — so it is safe to show a brand-new customer exactly what to gather.
      Parameters:
      type - the cloud provider type; null tolerated
      Returns:
      the authorization-key label, never blank

    • resolveCloudType

      public static CloudProviderType resolveCloudType(String providerLabel)
      Resolves a Fabric provider label ("AWS", "Amazon Web Services", "Azure ExpressRoute", ...) to a CloudProviderType, falling back to CloudProviderType.OTHER for a label that matches no well-known provider (a third-party service profile).
      Parameters:
      providerLabel - the provider label; null/blank tolerated
      Returns:
      the resolved type, never null

    • cloudAdapter

      public static CloudProviderConnectionAdapter<?> cloudAdapter(PlannedConnection connection)
      Builds a cloud-provider Z-side adapter from a planned connection's resolved provider fields (service-profile uuid, authorization key, seller region, and Azure peering type). Uniform across every provider — the typed reference adapters differ only in these same fields plus the provider type and (Azure) peering, all of which this carries — so IBM and Alibaba, which have no dedicated adapter, still send their authorization key and seller region.
      Parameters:
      connection - the planned provider connection
      Returns:
      an adapter suitable for ConnectionOperator.ConnectionBuilder.zSideCloudProvider(CloudProviderConnectionAdapter, LinkProtocol)

    • providerBody

      public static ConnectionOperator.ConnectionBuilder providerBody(Connections connections, PlannedConnection connection, String aSideRouterUuid)
      Assembles a provider connection body against a to-be-created (or already existing) Cloud Router identified by uuid. Used by the execution-time pre-flight + real create once the router uuid is known, and by the plan-time lens-3b dry-run when the caller supplies an existing Cloud Router.
      Parameters:
      connections - the Fabric connections client
      connection - the planned provider connection
      aSideRouterUuid - the real Cloud Router uuid to use as the A-side
      Returns:
      an un-terminated builder; chain .dryRun().create() or .create()

    • providerBodyOnPort

      public static ConnectionOperator.ConnectionBuilder providerBodyOnPort(Connections connections, PlannedConnection connection, String aSidePortUuid)
      Assembles a provider connection body against a pre-existing customer port as the A-side (lens 3b: the endpoint is real, so the connection can be dry-run at PLAN time).
      Parameters:
      connections - the Fabric connections client
      connection - the planned provider connection
      aSidePortUuid - the existing customer port uuid to use as the A-side
      Returns:
      an un-terminated builder; chain .dryRun().create() or .create()

    • backboneBody

      public static ConnectionOperator.ConnectionBuilder backboneBody(Connections connections, PlannedConnection connection, String aSideRouterUuid, String zSideRouterUuid)
      Assembles a backbone link body (Cloud Router to Cloud Router). Both router uuids must be known, so this is used at execution time once Phase 1 has provisioned the routers.
      Parameters:
      connections - the Fabric connections client
      connection - the planned backbone connection
      aSideRouterUuid - the A-side Cloud Router uuid
      zSideRouterUuid - the Z-side Cloud Router uuid
      Returns:
      an un-terminated builder; chain .dryRun().create() or .create()
